tipster.name: Market
tipster.style: Shortest posted 1X2 and total
tipster.bio: The book itself. Picks whatever price is shortest on the board.

fixture.venue: Estádio Dr. Jorge Ismael de Biasi

tipster.name: Line
tipster.style: Attack lean plus the over/under versus the posted line
tipster.bio: Same goal model as Attack, then posts the total against the listed line.

fixture.venue: Estádio Dr. Jorge Ismael de Biasi

tipster.name: Form
tipster.style: Points from the last five settled matches
tipster.bio: 3 for a win, 1 for a draw. Picks the side collecting more points.

fixture.venue: Estádio Dr. Jorge Ismael de Biasi

tipster.name: Pulse
tipster.style: Points from the last three only
tipster.bio: Ignores older form. Reads the last three results as the live run.

fixture.venue: Estádio Dr. Jorge Ismael de Biasi

tipster.name: Poisson
tipster.style: Independent Poisson on recent attack and defence
tipster.bio: Turns recent scoring rates into home / draw / away probabilities.

fixture.venue: Estádio Dr. Jorge Ismael de Biasi

tipster.name: Clean
tipster.style: The side conceding less, and a BTTS lean
tipster.bio: Picks the sturdier defence. Posts BTTS no when both sides have been tight.

fixture.venue: Estádio Dr. Jorge Ismael de Biasi

tipster.name: Attack
tipster.style: Expected goals from recent scoring and conceding
tipster.bio: Compares each side's recent goals for and against. Also posts the total and BTTS.

fixture.venue: Estádio Dr. Jorge Ismael de Biasi

tipster.name: Shield
tipster.style: Fewest goals conceded in the last five
tipster.bio: Trusts the tighter defence. Draws when the concession rates sit close.

fixture.venue: Estádio Dr. Jorge Ismael de Biasi

tipster.name: Elo
tipster.style: Points plus goal difference, with a home nudge
tipster.bio: A simple rating from recent points and goal difference. Home gets a small edge.

fixture.venue: Estádio Dr. Jorge Ismael de Biasi

tipster.name: Fire
tipster.style: Higher recent goals-for, and overs when both attack
tipster.bio: Follows the sharper attack. Goes over when both sides have been scoring.

fixture.venue: Estádio Dr. Jorge Ismael de Biasi

tipster.name: Both
tipster.style: Both-teams-to-score from recent scoring rates
tipster.bio: Posts BTTS from how often each side has scored. 1X2 follows form.

fixture.venue: Estádio Dr. Jorge Ismael de Biasi

tipster.name: Fortress
tipster.style: Home unless the away price is genuinely short
tipster.bio: Starts at home. Only flips when the away side is the clear posted favourite.

fixture.venue: Estádio Dr. Jorge Ismael de Biasi

tipster.name: Value
tipster.style: Fades a heavy favourite when form is close
tipster.bio: If the favourite is very short and recent points are tight, it takes the other side.

fixture.venue: Estádio Dr. Jorge Ismael de Biasi

tipster.name: Banker
tipster.style: Only posts when the favourite is 55% implied or shorter
tipster.bio: Skips toss-ups. Only speaks when the posted favourite is genuinely short.

fixture.venue: Estádio Dr. Jorge Ismael de Biasi

tipster.name: Grit
tipster.style: Wins plus draws over the last five
tipster.bio: Unbeaten rate, not just wins. Useful when a side keeps grinding results.

fixture.venue: Estádio Dr. Jorge Ismael de Biasi

tipster.name: Run
tipster.style: Win rate over the last five
tipster.bio: Counts wins only — draws do not count. The streak desk.

fixture.venue: Estádio Dr. Jorge Ismael de Biasi

tipster.name: Road
tipster.style: Away sides that keep pace with home form
tipster.bio: Picks the visitors when their recent points sit close to or above the hosts.

fixture.venue: Estádio Dr. Jorge Ismael de Biasi

tipster.name: Blend
tipster.style: Majority of Market, Form, and Attack
tipster.bio: Votes the three core desks and takes the side that wins the ballot.

fixture.venue: Estádio Dr. Jorge Ismael de Biasi

tipster.name: Bounce
tipster.style: The worse recent form — a bounce play
tipster.bio: Takes the side that has been worse. Mean-reversion, not momentum.

fixture.venue: Estádio Dr. Jorge Ismael de Biasi

tipster.name: Contrarian
tipster.style: Opposite of the posted favourite
tipster.bio: Always takes the other side of the market. The dissent desk.

fixture.venue: Estádio Dr. Jorge Ismael de Biasi

tipster.name: Split
tipster.style: Draw when the two prices sit on top of each other
tipster.bio: If home and away are nearly the same price, it posts the draw. Otherwise the favourite.

fixture.venue: Estádio Dr. Jorge Ismael de Biasi

tipster.name: Cut
tipster.style: Favourite only when implied is above 48%, else the draw
tipster.bio: Needs a real favourite. If nobody is short enough, it posts the draw.

fixture.venue: Estádio Dr. Jorge Ismael de Biasi
